license: project license; no upstream implementation copied

conceptual_references.implementation: LiLiCoRR paper lattice is separately adapted in lilicorr.py; this empirical source-selection critic is an original extension, not the published trained lattice
Existing tree mechanism reviewed for optional parent-prefix closure; pool budget is 15 complete sequences, which can require 225 token nodes

modifications: Revision-bound loaded-source admission and immutable complete causal token paths; no unavailable checkpoint/provider fabrication
Deduplicate identical full sequences while retaining all provider source/revision/candidate provenance; preserve all full paths in optional parent-prefix closure
Rank up to 15 complete sequences by a product-of-conditional-reliability proxy for accepted-token count, optionally divided by explicit same-unit declared or previously observed cost
Within-source beam scores provide transparent ordinals only; cold equal predictions interleave source ordinals without comparing uncalibrated logits between sources

Original LiLiCoRR-inspired source-selection critic: bounded global mechanism priors, target/tokenizer/vocabulary and source-revision-bound model residuals, opaque hashed session residuals; neutral priors and explicit hierarchical shrinkage with same-source confidence bins

Separate selection tickets, discard, and whole-outer-round committed target-prefix feedback; matching prefixes positive, first delivered mismatch negative, later suffixes censored; same-source prefix events and same-artifact aliases deduplicated
Shared registry explicit opt-in with lock, bounded model/session/source LRU retention and revision/sample-count/eviction receipts; raw tenant or session names not accepted
Exact execution requires drawing from processed target law then following candidate-prefix matches; no mixed/refined joint q distribution exported

Source-model residual identity additionally includes deterministic full route/settings revision, avoiding window/pass/beam/computation-precision policy bleed; pool-local feedback revision and shared ranking revision appear separately in immutable tickets and receipts

Original bounded M3 harness measures resident B1 full-provider proposal cost at one fixed committed context instead of declaring zero; warmup discarded, target depth0..15 and widths1/5/15 measured separately, timed proposal probes discard authenticated pending tickets and restore both cache/RNG/history boundaries without publishing labels or costs to the critic

Harness computation precision creates separate deterministic route/source session pins and fresh isolated critic namespace before generation; FP32 diagnostic source artifacts remain unchanged and memory guard precedes payload allocation

boundaries.ranking_score: empirical proxy, not a calibrated joint continuation probability, throughput result, pretrained source critic, or exact acceptance forecast
boundaries.source_admission: provider asserts actually loaded compatible tensor source; host pool independently validates record pins and geometry only
boundaries.teacher_authority: caller must supply actually delivered target prefix only after every physical group commits; host registry does not independently attest teacher execution
boundaries.global_sharing: global priors intentionally aggregate only mechanism-position reliability; model/session residuals remain source/model-revision and opaque session-hash bound
boundaries.sampling: pool path ranking affects candidate reuse only; processed target law defines each delivered token
boundaries.gpu: no GPU executed for host pool tests

Strict public-registry validation, feature calibration after committed observations only, route/settings-revision residual separation, and64 concurrent host commits verify counts. Joint focused pool/provider/branch-executor CPU suite:63 passed; no GPU or performance run. Harness:16 CPU/CLI tests cover hard tensor-import guarded dry runs, explicit GPU ownership, bounded geometry/deadline/repetitions, FP32/artifact source-pin and critic isolation, pending-binding rejection, fake partial-provider fault cleanup and actual tiny XPress resident proposal rollback without feedback.
